I now have sufficient evidence to build a comprehensive report. Let me compile everything.

### SUMMARY

I read and analyzed all three specified JavaScript files to identify scroll-driven mechanisms that could cause jank. The Shorthand runtime (`story.667703.min.js`) contains **multiple aggressive scroll-driven systems**: a full scroll-driven parallax/scene animation engine with ResizeObserver-driven text recalculations, a `document.addEventListener("scroll", ...)` listener for multi-video audio management that calls `getBoundingClientRect()` on every scroll frame, a `requestAnimationFrame`-driven reading progress bar that reads `scrollY`/`scrollHeight`/`clientHeight` on every animation frame, a custom element-resize-detection system using hidden scroll containers (scrollLeft/scrollTop manipulation for resize detection), an `IntersectionObserver` for autoplay video with `rootMargin: "0px"`, a `window.matchMedia("print")` listener, a `visibilitychange` handler, and a `fullscreenchange` listener on videos. The `footer.667703.min.js` adds a passive `window.addEventListener("scroll", ji)` for a sticky footer reveal effect with `{passive: true}`, plus a `resize`/`orientationchange` listener for responsive footer layout. `inline-01.js` contains a FastDOM-based system with a passive `window.addEventListener("resize")` handler for focal-point picture orientation changes.

### EVIDENCE

- **js/story.667703.min.js:1** — **Scroll-driven scene/animation engine** (the "Scroll" detection library). Contains a complete scroll-based animation system with element-resize detection via hidden container scrollLeft/scrollTop manipulation (`vl()` function sets `bl.scrollLeft=Tl, bl.scrollTop=Sl, Ql.scrollLeft=P, Ql.scrollTop=A`). Includes `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener` wrappers `F`/`p`, a `listeners` array system, and `animationstart` event handling. Injects hidden divs with `overflow: hidden` and `z-index: -1` for resize detection.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:1** — **ResizeObserver on text panels** (`globalThis.window.ResizeObserver && (this.textObserver=new ResizeObserver(...))`). Observes text block elements; on resize, calls `getBoundingClientRect()` on all children (`Tb()` = height measurement), recalculates scene, and calls `updateScene(this.getScrollPosition())`.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:37** — **Panel scene scroll handler**: `this.on("scroll", b=>{this.updateScene(b)})`. The `updateScene()` method applies opacity, clipPath, position, zIndex, and display toggles via `style.setProperty` / `style.display`. Also dispatches `"panel-item-selected"` CustomEvent on scroll position changes.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:37** — **`scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"center"})`** triggered by `"panel-item-selected"` events (from click source).

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **Reading Progress Bar** — Custom Element (`nV`) with `updateProgressBar = ()=> { globalThis.window.requestAnimationFrame(() => { let V = globalThis.window.scrollY, ... }) }`. Every rAF reads `scrollY`, `scrollHeight`, `clientHeight`, computes % and applies `scaleX()` transform.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **`IntersectionObserver` for autoplay video** (`new IntersectionObserver(mG, {root: null, rootMargin: "0px", threshold: 0.1})`). Observed on all `[data-videoplayer]` elements with `autoplay="true"`. Calls `play()`/`pause()` on intersection.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **`document.addEventListener("scroll", xV)` for video audio management**. Dynamically added/removed via `hV()` function. The `xV()` handler iterates all playing videos, calls `getBoundingClientRect()` on each (`yR(l)`), computes distance to viewport center (`AR`), and mutes/unmutes based on closest-to-center.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **`visibilitychange` module** (`ib`). Exports `hidden` property name and `visibilitychange` event name for browser-prefixed detection.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **`window.matchMedia("print")` listener** (`RV()`). Listens to print media changes, toggles carousel containers (`display:none`).

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **`resize` event listener** (`dV()`: `window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>Ii(), {passive:true})`). Triggers `Ii()` which performs parallax split-layout calculations with `transform` mutations.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:43** — **Parent-width resizing system** (`aV`/`WV`/`Ot`). Custom resize detection using an external listener (`RR.listenTo`) on parent elements. Reads `clientWidth` and `Bi(d)` (computed inner width) via `getComputedStyle`, then mutates `style.width`. Used for `.ParentWidth` and `.FullSize__fixedChild.ObjectFit--cover` elements.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:82** — **`fullscreenchange`** event listener on video elements for Level layer class toggling.

- **js/story.667703.min.js:1** — **FastDOM bundled** (`K` module). Same FastDOM implementation as inline-01.js. Used extensively for measure/mutate batching across the runtime.

- **js/footer.667703.min.js:9** — **Passive `window.addEventListener("scroll", ji)`** — sticky footer reveal. Reads `window.scrollY`, `document.body.offsetHeight`, `window.innerHeight`, calculates scroll %, sets footer position with `style.bottom`/`style.opacity` transitions via FastDOM `mutate()`.

- **js/footer.667703.min.js:9** — **Resize/orientationchange listener** (`Xo`): `window.addEventListener(e, ..., {passive: true})` where `e` is `"resize"` or `"orientationchange"`. Reads `document.body.offsetWidth` and `window.innerWidth` via FastDOM `measure()`.

- **js/footer.667703.min.js:9** — **`requestAnimationFrame`** used in the back-to-top button: `requestAnimationFrame(()=>l.focus())`.

- **js/footer.667703.min.js:9** — **FastDOM** (duplicated `ge` module). Same implementation, used for batched measure/mutate throughout footer.

- **js/inline-01.js:183-203** — **Passive `resize` listener**: `window.addEventListener("resize", () => u(), {passive: true})`. The handler `u()` runs FastDOM `measure()` → reads orientation via `innerWidth`/`innerHeight` → then `mutate()` to set `object-position` on focal-point images.

- **js/inline-01.js:46-52** — **FastDOM implementation** (`c` module). Includes `requestAnimationFrame` polyfill (falls back to `setTimeout(..., 16)`).

### CHANGES

None.

### RISKS

- **Scroll listener jank from xV()**: The `document.addEventListener("scroll", xV)` handler (video audio prioritization) iterates all playing videos and calls `getBoundingClientRect()` on each one during every scroll event. On pages with many videos, this synchronous layout read per scroll frame will cause forced layouts (layout thrashing). Using FastDOM `measure()` would batch these reads.
- **rAF progress bar reads layout on every frame**: `updateProgressBar()` runs on every rAF (even when the page is not scrolling) reading `scrollY`, `scrollHeight`, `clientHeight`. This is unthrottled and runs at 60fps continuously. Should be gated on actual scroll events.
- **ResizeObserver + getBoundingClientRect in text panels**: The `ResizeObserver` callback calls `getBoundingClientRect()` on every child element (`Tb()`), then recalculates and mutates visual properties. During resize events (e.g., orientation change), this could cause many layout recalculations in a single frame.
- **Hidden scroll-container resize detection**: The element-resize-detection technique (used in `aV`/`WV` system and the Scroll library) uses hidden containers with `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop` manipulation and `animationstart` events. This pattern can trigger many resize checks and DOM mutations, especially during scroll on mobile where viewport size changes.
- **Multiple independent scroll listeners**: story.667703.min.js has at least 3 separate scroll-driven systems (scene animation, video audio management, progress bar) plus the footer's scroll listener — all active simultaneously. None are throttle/debounced.

### BLOCKERS

None.

Now I have all the data I need. Let me compile my comprehensive analysis.

### SUMMARY

I read all 10 CSS files (totaling ~4,500+ lines) and systematically cataloged every expensive rendering property that impacts scroll performance. The site uses multiple sticky scrollmation layers (`position: sticky` with `100vh` media), animated cinematic backgrounds with `will-change`, SVG noise grain overlays on large sections, infinite `@keyframes` animations on `.bpt-kicker` (letter-spacing breathe), multiple `mix-blend-mode` layers (screen, overlay, soft-light), large `box-shadow` on full-viewport elements, and animated CSS gradients on `::before`/`::after` pseudo-elements. Many `backdrop-filter` declarations are commented out — a good sign — but `will-change` is overused and `position: fixed/sticky` elements with transforms are frequent. The worst offender is ch2-bao-ton.css with its 300vh sticky background section, animated film grain, and 200%×200% noise SVG.

### EVIDENCE

- **Rank #1 — Sticky background with huge SVG noise grain animation**: `css/chapters/ch2-bao-ton.css:222-240` — `.bpt-nghe-nhan__grain` uses `position: absolute; inset: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%` with an SVG `feTurbulence` noise image and animates `transform` every 0.5s via `@keyframes bpt-grain-shift`. This causes a full-viewport paint on every frame during scroll. Also at `css/custom/base.css:294-369` — `.v2-transition-layer` has 4 animated pseudo-elements with infinite `@keyframes` (light-sweep, top-line, orb, ribbon) + `mix-blend-mode: screen`.

- **Rank #2 — Sticky scrollmation with full-viewport media**: `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:148-156` — `.bpt-sm-media` is `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; width: 100%`. The `.bpt-sm-slide` children at lines 159-168 have `transition: opacity 0.65s` and `transform: scale(1.06)`. Slide transitions during scroll trigger paint on the full viewport. Also `css/chapters/ch2-bao-ton.css:119-127` — `.bpt-nghe-nhan__bg` is `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh` with `overflow: hidden`, and `css/chapters/ch2-bao-ton.css:272-298` — `.bpt-nghe-nhan__reveal` also sticky with cross-fade images.

- **Rank #3 — Infinite `@keyframes text-breathe` on `.bpt-kicker`**: `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:990-997` — `.bpt-kicker { animation: text-breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite; }`. This animates `letter-spacing` on *all* kickers throughout the site, triggering layout reflows (not just repaints) every 4 seconds. Layout-triggering infinite animation is serious.

- **Rank #4 — `mix-blend-mode` on large fixed/absolute layers**: `css/custom/base.css:157` — `::before` pseudo on all sections has `mix-blend-mode: soft-light` + animated `transform: translate3d(...)` and gradient background. `css/custom/base.css:227` — `.scene-wipe` has `mix-blend-mode: screen` (though `display: none` on mobile, it's present on desktop). `css/custom/base.css:247` — `.scene-orb` has `mix-blend-mode: screen`. `css/custom/base.css:302` — `.v2-transition-layer` has `mix-blend-mode: screen`. Each `mix-blend-mode` layer forces the compositor to rasterize the full layer stack.

- **Rank #5 — `will-change` abuse**: `css/custom/base.css:174` — `.scene-progress { will-change: transform; }` (fixed element, fine). `css/custom/base.css:191` — `.scene-orb { will-change: transform; }` (fixed, fine). `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:52` — `.bpt-zoom-scene__visual { will-change: transform; }` (large element, ok). `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:550` — `.bpt-sm-panel--cinematic .bpt-sm-text { will-change: transform, opacity; }` (multiple text panels). `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:615,635` — `.bpt-magazine-photo` and `.bpt-magazine-photo-inner { will-change: transform, opacity; contain: layout style paint; }` (these two have proper `contain` — good). `css/chapters/ch2-bao-ton.css:140,154,297,314` — `.bpt-nghe-nhan__bg-img`, `__bg-layer`, `__reveal-top`, `__particle` all have `will-change`. The main concern is `css/custom/base.css:312` — `.v2-transition-layer::before, ::after, span, i { will-change: transform, opacity; }` spans 4 elements with infinite CSS animations — each reserves a compositor layer unnecessarily.

- **Rank #6 — Large `box-shadow` on full-width elements**: `css/custom/base.css:63` — `.intro-card { box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); }`. `css/custom/ch1-layout.css:197` — `.bpt-inline-visual img { box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); }`. `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:21` — `.bpt-split-scene__visual .bpt-placeholder-img { box-shadow: 0 32px 100px rgb(34 26 20 / 0.15); }`. `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:61` — `.bpt-zoom-scene__visual img { box-shadow: 0 32px 100px rgb(34 26 20 / 0.18); }`. `css/custom/ch1-layout.css:351` — `.bpt-split-scene__visual img { box-shadow: 0 32px 100px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); }`. Large blur-radius box-shadows require blur rasterization at paint time.

- **Rank #7 — SVG noise grain as base64 background-image on section pseudos**: `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:953-961` — `.bpt-sm-panel::before` has SVG `feTurbulence` background-image at `opacity: 0.03`. Same pattern at `css/custom/ch2-enhancements.css:284-292` — `.bpt-scene::before`. While opacity is low, the SVG filter-based noise is expensive to paint and covers the full section area.

- **Rank #8 — `position: fixed` elements with transitions/transform**: `css/custom/base.css:164-175` — `.scene-progress` is `position: fixed; width: 100%; height: 3px` with `will-change: transform`. `css/custom/base.css:177-192` — `.scene-orb` is `position: fixed; width: min(34vw, 420px)` with `mix-blend-mode: overlay`. `css/custom/base.css:213-234` — `.scene-wipe` is `position: fixed; inset: -18vh -16vw` with `mix-blend-mode: screen`. `css/custom/ch1-scenes.css:1007-1018` — `.bpt-scroll-hint` is `position: fixed`. `css/chapters/ch2-bao-ton.css:606-614` — `.bpt-nghe-nhan__scroll-hint` is `position: fixed`.

- **Rank #9 — Infinite cursor hint animations with `filter: drop-shadow`**: `css/chapters/ch2-ngu-hanh.css:397-409` — `.cursor-hint { animation: cursorMove 3s ease-in-out infinite; }` uses `filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px ...)`. While small, `drop-shadow` triggers paint and runs infinitely. Also `css/chapters/ch2-ngu-hanh.css:437-447` — multiple cursor hint animations with `filter: drop-shadow`.

- **Rank #10 — `filter: drop-shadow` on inline SVG icons**: `css/chapters/ch2-ngu-hanh.css:205-207` — `.bpt-hanh-card .hc-img { filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25)); }`. While small, `drop-shadow` per card element adds paint overhead.

### NEXT

1. **Kill the animated SVG grain on sticky backgrounds** (`ch2-bao-ton.css:222-240`): Replace the `.bpt-nghe-nhan__grain` CSS animation with a static CSS grain overlay or a single composite layer. The `@keyframes bpt-grain-shift` runs every 0.5s on a 200%×200% noise element inside a sticky 100vh container — this is the single biggest layout/paint cost.

2. **Remove `animation: text-breathe` from `.bpt-kicker`** (`ch1-scenes.css:995-997`): `letter-spacing` animation triggers layout. Replace with `opacity` or `transform`-based animation, or remove the infinite loop.

3. **Audit `will-change` usage**: Remove `will-change: transform, opacity` from `.v2-transition-layer` pseudos (`base.css:312`) and `.bpt-sm-panel--cinematic .bpt-sm-text` (`ch1-scenes.css:550`). Only add `will-change` on elements that are actively animating during scroll, not on all elements pre-emptively.

4. **Replace SVG `feTurbulence` noise background-images** with CSS `background-image` using a tiny pre-rendered PNG noise tile (~200 bytes) instead of inline SVG filters. SVG filters must be parsed and rasterized per-paint. See `ch1-scenes.css:957`, `ch2-enhancements.css:288`.

5. **Replace multi-layered `mix-blend-mode` with single-layer effects** where possible. The `.v2-transition-layer` (`base.css:295-369`) has 4 animated pseudo-elements with `mix-blend-mode: screen` — consider collapsing into one or using `opacity` alone.

6. **For ch2 sticky parallax** (`ch2-bao-ton.css`), add `contain: paint style layout` to `.bpt-nghe-nhan__bg` and `.bpt-nghe-nhan__reveal` to create compositing layers and reduce paint area.

7. **Reduce blur-radius on large `box-shadow` values**: Box-shadows with blur > 40px are expensive to blur-rasterize. Consider scaling back the 80-100px blur box-shadows or using a semi-transparent gradient overlay instead.

### RISKS

- The `letter-spacing` animation (`text-breathe`) is a layout-triggering property — removing it may change the visual feel. Mitigation: switch to `opacity` pulsing or `transform: scale(1.01)` for a breathing effect that only triggers composite, not layout.
- Several `backdrop-filter` rules are commented out but the shim property `-webkit-backdrop-filter` is also commented — uncommenting even one would create a full-viewport paint cost on every scroll. Mitigation: keep them commented, and if re-enabling, scope `backdrop-filter` to small elements only.
- The SVG noise grain layers have very low opacity (0.025–0.03), so removing them is visually safe but the aesthetic was intentional. Mitigation: replace with a tiny PNG overlay tile.
- The `will-change: transform` on `.scene-progress` (fixed progress bar) is actually well-placed — removing it could cause jank on the progress bar animation. Mitigation: keep that one, remove the profligate others.
- `filter: drop-shadow` on `.bpt-hanh-card .hc-img` and cursor elements is low-cost per element but many instances add up. Mitigation: only show drop-shadow on hover/active states, not at rest.
